text:
aria_sales: Quick heads-up — NebulaHealth POC needs a compliance proofpack before EOD Friday. Ask list: SOC 2 excerpt (control matrix PDF), signed pen-test letter for our staging environment, and a rough delta for providing an on-prem staging image vs hosted POC. Can owners claim these? @sam_se @julia_compliance @ben_security

sam_se: I can own the staging pen-test logistics. Does Nebula want the pen-test letter to name specific IPs or just a generic attestation for our staging cluster?

julia_compliance: For SOC2 excerpt — we can provide the control matrix excerpt and the SOC2 Type II cover page + scope PDF. We should redact internal hostnames. Will need ~1 business day to pull redacted copies.

ben_security: Pen-test letter: we can sign an attestation confirming an internal third-party test was performed and list the scope as 'staging environment (isolated)'. We cannot disclose vuln details. Who is the signatory? Legal prefers a Director-level sign-off.

aria_sales: Nebula asked for signed letter addressed to their CISO (Lisa M.). They also asked if the pen-test can be run by their third-party on our staging — that'll need controls + a short window.

sam_se: If they want to run their tester, we need: 1) scoped IP range, 2) a 4-hour maintenance window, 3) ephemeral creds + jumpbox. We can offer a hosted window OR provide an on-prem image (extra ops cost).

julia_compliance: If external pentest is allowed, we need NDA addendum + POA from Legal and an approval from security. That adds ~2-3 business days. We should be explicit: we won't allow exploitation of customer data or production access.

ben_security: Agreed. Also: if we allow external scans against staging, require read-only telemetry access and presigned S3 upload for findings. No creds that persist.

aria_sales: Pricing question — Nebula wants an estimate for the on-prem staging option. Sam, can you pull a delta? They expect a ballpark today to not stall procurement.

sam_se: Ballpark: one-time packaging + validation = $12k, shipping/support for staging = $2k/mo. If they want remote support for pentest coordination add $1.5k for the window. I'll confirm exacts by EOD.

julia_compliance: I'll prepare the SOC2 excerpt PDF and redact hostnames. ETA noon tomorrow.

ben_security: I'll draft the pen-test attestation template. Quick draft here:

```
[Company Letterhead]
To: NebulaHealth CISO (Lisa M.)
Re: Penetration Test Attestation — Staging Environment
We hereby confirm that Redwood Inference engaged/accredited third-party security testers to perform a penetration test scoped to the isolated staging cluster for the NebulaHealth POC. The test was limited to the following test targets: [redacted IP range or description]. Findings classification and remediation details are withheld from third parties per contract; a high-level summary can be provided on request.
Signed,
[Director, Security]
```

ben_security: Legal will want to review language about findings. I can route to Legal once we have the addressed draft.

evidence-bot: Created ticket EVID-2026 for NebulaHealth proofpack and attached a checklist: SOC2 excerpt, pen-test letter, NDA addendum, staging access checklist. Owner: aria_sales.

aria_sales: Perfect. Next steps: Sam — final delta for on-prem by EOD; Julia — SOC2 excerpt noon tomorrow; Ben — pen-test draft for legal review today if possible. I'll keep Nebula updated and try to push procurement a nonblocking estimate. Thanks all :thumbsup:

sam_se: On it.

julia_compliance: Will post the PDF link here when ready.

ben_security: Drafting now, should have something for Legal by 16:00 PST.

aria_sales: FYI — Nebula asked if we can include a simple network diagram showing staging isolation. Sam, can you paste a minimal ASCII diagram?

sam_se: Sure — small diagram below:

```
[Internet] --- VPN Gateway --- Staging Jumpbox --- Isolated Staging Cluster (no prod peering)
```

aria_sales: Awesome. I'll package that with the evidence bundle. Closing loop after motions complete.
